name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.68 / build 69 refines chat bubbles, System avatars and animated typing, with a one-second introduction and support acknowledgement. Matching desktop/backend sources add workspace/history unread indicators, immediate observed-message read feedback, a stable sliding identity menu and a top-right End confirmation. Website Back/minimize preserves the guest conversation in page memory; refresh/page exit ends it. Registered mobile conversations remain saved across exit/logout. Typing never transmits drafts or creates notifications. The Help Bot transcript and booking details are not automatically shared. Physical-phone installation and actual notification delivery are not verified. Existing development signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval.
